fields.System.Title: CNT-503 — Reconcile and post results
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want the full count reconciled and posted as one exercise,
so that the warehouse restarts from a known-correct position.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given all locations counted, then a full variance report is produced against the
  • freeze snapshot.
  • - Given variances above threshold, then recounts are required before any posting.
  • - Given approval, then all adjustments post with a full-count reason code linked to the
  • count.
  • - Given posting, then the total financial impact is reported and published to the ERP.
  • - Given posting, then the ledger-vs-balance reconciliation passes immediately afterwards.
  • - Given posting, then it is idempotent — a retry does not double-adjust.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory, platform |
| Tables | variance, adjustment, stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Double posting ([doc 09 §3.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); ledger left unreconciled ([doc 09 §11.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency · invariant |
